name: The Friendly Guys Pool Cleaners
services: Weekly pool cleaning (vacuuming, netting, brushing walls/steps/tiles)
Water testing and chemical balancing (pH, chlorine, alkalinity, calcium hardness, cyanuric acid, salt systems)
Filter cleaning and backwashing (cartridge, sand, DE)
Automatic pool cleaner (bag/filter) cleaning and verification
Algae treatment/removal, backed by a 'No Algae Guarantee'
Spa/hot tub cleaning (for pools with an attached spa)
Two service tiers: All-Inclusive Plan (starting $159/month) and Standard Plan (starting $129/month)
source_notes: Services and pricing pulled directly from pontevedrabeachpoolguys.com (home, /full-service-plan-pool-cleaning.cfm, /partial-service-plan-pool-cleaning.cfm, /satisfaction-guarantee.cfm) via Nimble extract on 2026-07-13. I'm Anthony Carey, the owner of The Friendly Guys Pool Cleaners' -- matches and confirms the candidate name given. PHOTOS: no genuine owner-uploaded photos (truck, team, completed pool) were found -- the only images on-site are generic template graphics/product-brand logos (Pentair, Hayward, Polaris, Jandy), a coverage-area map graphic, and stock-style plan illustrations shared verbatim across the same-template sister sites noted above, so none are reported here as authentic business photos.
